reviews_5s:
I bought my first one in the 1990s. When that one began to rust I pitched it and didn’t get a replacement until the early 2000s. That one rusted out in about 2010 and I’ve been looking for a replacement until I just found this one.

You may wonder why I keep buying this product knowing it’s going to rust out. Because it is inexpensive and save me a lot of time when I need to use it. Works well when making potato salad and egg salad.I bought this because I saw a video online of someone using it to make egg salad.. This is the best for cutting up hardboiled eggs! It makes the job fast and easy. Easy cleanup, too. Highly recommended.

I can hardly wait to try it with potatoes. I've been using a cookie cooling rack to do my mashed potatoes for a long time, but it's really big and hard to hold over a bowl. This little grater seems perfect for that job.the size is good, is durable steel which is really high cuality. I like it a lot.Only certain very specific graters do a good job for our potato kugel, this one is right there, it did a great job.I love this item I use it every time I make egg salad, just push the boiled egg threw the wire and your finished, no messI grew up with my Aunt having one of these. She’d make potato salad, soup, french fries, and egg salad in a snap! I found one at a yard sale when i was newly married and grabbed it up! This one was somewhat rusty. I longed to find one to buy. My son found this one and gave it to me for Christmas. . I bought several more and gave them to both sisters. Even got one for my camper. It’s the best ever!!I've been looking for this product for many years. My Mom had one most of her life until Hurricane Katrina 🌀 got it. Marilyn only used it for making egg 🥚 salad. Now I see its multitalented traits. Mom became Departed Enlightened And Delighted back in 2016 at almost age 90. I will have fond memories 😊 of her when I use it 👌 I've sent the link for it to my brother Richard. He may want more than one for his restaurant Scranton's here in Pascagoula Mississippi. It does it’s purpose but with modern technology I’m sure there are more updated graters to use but are more expensive.
